prompt: Complete the situation: His captain was injured before a crucial match, he was asked to lead the team?
completion: He accepted the responsibility, motivated the team and they won the match.

prompt: Complete the situation: You are an officer posted at the border and suddenly shelling happens from the other side, you will
completion: Order troops to stay in shell-proof bunkers, inform the CO and request for counter shelling.

prompt: Complete the situation: You are in an unknown city and lost your purse. You need money. As a stranger how will you manage?
completion: I will go to the police station, report the loss and contact my family for help.

prompt: Complete the situation: He was traveling by train and suddenly a person snatches purse from lady and jumps out of train. He
completion: He pulls chain, jumps down and catches the criminal, recovers purse and hands over criminal to police.

prompt: Complete the situation: In a discussion with your colleagues, you find yourself losing ground, you will
completion: Listen to their arguments, accept valid points and modify my view if their logic is sound.

prompt: Complete the situation: He was to appear for an exam and all of a sudden the curfew was imposed in that area, he
completion: Contacted the exam authorities, explained the situation, showed his admit card and sought police escort.

prompt: Complete the situation: There is a person who sells smuggled goods. You too have purchased a wristwatch from him. But it doesn't work. You'll
completion: Confront the seller about the defective product and demand a replacement or refund.

prompt: Complete the situation: Just two days before the semi-finals of the bridge tournament, his partner was called by his parents and had to go out of station. He
completion: Found a suitable replacement, practiced with him and participated in the tournament.

prompt: Complete the situation: He was rather young when his father was killed in the war and later mother kidnapped by the rival group. He had no other relative. He
completion: Contacted the police and social services, sought help from authorities and fought the case legally.

prompt: Complete the situation: He receives conflicting orders from his two superior officers. He
completion: Politely explained the situation to both seniors, sought clarification and followed the correct chain of command.

prompt: Complete the situation: He was going to attend SSB interview. On reaching the Railway Station he noticed that his suitcase has been stolen with his original certificates. He
completion: Immediately lodged an FIR, went back and got the original certificates from the college and then attended SSB.

prompt: Complete the situation: While he was traveling on his scooter, someone at gunpoint demanded his purse. He
completion: Stayed calm, tried to alert nearby people, noted the criminal's features and informed the police immediately.

prompt: Complete the situation: He was going on a bicycle in thick jungle. It was already dark and his destination was 10 Km away. His cycle got punctured. He
completion: Walked with the cycle to destination.

prompt: Complete the situation: He is new in the city. Suddenly he noticed that all his items were stolen. He had no money in his pocket. He
completion: Went to the nearest police station, filed a report, contacted his family for financial help and arranged for basic necessities.

prompt: Complete the situation: You are getting late in reaching meeting. You would
completion: Call the concerned person, explain the situation, apologize and give expected time of arrival.
